_about: The standing attack list: every red-team check the engine has faced, numbered, with the script that runs it, the record it writes, and the question it tries to break. run_attacks.py --check refuses a missing record and a record made on a different engine commit than the live deck (the 10/19 finding: the engine changed under the report). A new attack is a new row; a row is never deleted, only marked retired with the date.

attacks.name: known-answer re-implementation of the category math
attacks.question: Does a from-scratch z-score, availability, board and weekly FG%/PTS model reproduce the engine to the last digit?

attacks.name: kit vs deck line join
attacks.question: Do the two planes carry the same lines for the same players, with no alias or surname false pairing?

attacks.name: card measure vs simulator realized rates
attacks.question: Does the card's ECW rank the same as the seasons' title share, and are the category edges it quotes the ones the seasons realize?

attacks.name: integer ties the simulator cannot produce
attacks.question: How often does a real weekly category tie, and does the continuous model see any of it?

attacks.name: structural sensitivity (format and tiers)
attacks.question: Does the title share survive the format assumptions one at a time: weeks, bracket, standings rule, tiers, shock, variance, category independence?

attacks.name: decision robustness
attacks.question: Do the two headline swap verdicts stay positive under every A-5 variant?

attacks.name: constants registry vs live engine
attacks.question: Does every judgment constant the engine runs on still equal its registered value, carry a calibration status, and name what vouches for it?

attacks.name: assumption sweep from the registry
attacks.question: Which hand-set constants move the title share by 2 points or more, and does every report quote those bands?

attacks.name: separate-attacker re-implementation of the season simulator
attacks.question: Does a from-spec implementation, written by an agent that never saw arena.py, reproduce the simulator's availability tiers, daily-fill hash and start weights, weekly team model, category probabilities and season title/playoff shares?

attacks.name: IL-return scenario known answers
attacks.question: Do the IL-return scenarios reduce to the headline when every return is after the last week, to include_il when every return is week 1 with the room rule off, and do the owner's own returns never lower his title odds? (Until 2026-11-11 also: does seat 10's title fall monotonically with the slip; those worlds are no longer run.)
history: 2026-11-12: re-run failed one check (rt_il_return_2026-11-12_FAILED.json); il_players fixed on the owner's pick; record re-made by il_return.py --checks --attack-record, with the script's sha256

attacks.name: Drop-order decision robustness
attacks.question: Does the order of the owner's candidate drop pairs for the two IL returns hold under every non-zero variant of the assumption sweep?
